caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with irregular, slightly frayed edges. The background color of the fabric is a muted brown. The fabric is adorned with a floral pattern featuring large, detailed flowers and leaves. The flowers are primarily rendered in shades of light pink, red, and blue, with some of the petals shaded in a gradient that moves from light to dark. The leaves accompanying the flowers are mostly blue with red veins and outlines, and some leaves show a combination of blue and pink. The floral elements are connected and intertwined with slender, curved stems depicted in red. The arrangement of the flowers and leaves is spread evenly across the brown background, with the largest flowers positioned toward the upper center and left of the fabric, and smaller clustered flowers near the bottom right. The design covers the entire inner area of the brown fabric, leaving only a narrow border of the off-white background visible around the edges.
title: Printed Calico
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
